name: GIGABYTE B850M DS3H ICE AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard
shortDescription: GIGABYTE B850M DS3H ICE AM5 Motherboard - All White Edition (Socket AM5 / AMD B850 Chipset / 8+2+2 Digital VRM / Dual Channel DDR5 up to 8000+ MT/s OC / PCIe 4.0 x16 / 1x PCIe 5.0 M.2 + 1x PCIe 4.0 M.2 / Realtek 2.5GbE L
descriptionHtml:
GIGABYTE B850M DS3H ICE AM5 Motherboard - All White Edition (Socket AM5 / AMD B850 Chipset / 8+2+2 Digital VRM / Dual Channel DDR5 up to 8000+ MT/s OC / PCIe 4.0 x16 / 1x PCIe 5.0 M.2 + 1x PCIe 4.0 M.2 / Realtek 2.5GbE LAN / USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C / EZ-Latch / Micro-ATX Form Factor)

Build a sleek, high-performance all-white PC with the GIGABYTE B850M DS3H ICE AM5 Motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring an all-white PCB and silver-white thermal heatsinks, this Micro-ATX motherboard is optimized for AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. It comes equipped with an 8+2+2 Digital VRM power delivery solution, high-speed DDR5 memory support, ultra-fast PCIe 5.0 M.2 storage capabilities, Realtek 2.5GbE LAN, versatile USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C connectivity, and DIY-friendly EZ-Latch mechanisms for hassle-free building.

Technical Specifications

FeatureSpecification Details
Brand & ModelGIGABYTE B850M DS3H ICE (rev. 1.0)
Color Theme & DesignAll-White ICE Aesthetic (White PCB, White Connectors & Silver Heatsinks)
CPU Socket & ChipsetAMD Socket AM5 / AMD B850 Chipset (Supports Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Processors)
Power Delivery (VRM)8+2+2 Phase Digital VRM Power Solution with Extended Heatsink Armor
Memory Support4 x DDR5 DIMM Slots (Up to 256GB Dual Channel / AMD EXPO & Intel XMP Support / OC up to 8000+ MT/s)
PCIe Expansion Slots1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot (PCIe 4.0 x8/x4 mode on Ryzen 8000 Series) + 1 x PCIe 3.0 x1 Slot
M.2 & SATA Storage1 x M.2 PCIe 5.0 x4 Slot (M2A_CPU) + 1 x M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 Slot (M2B_SB) + 4 x SATA 6Gb/s Ports (RAID 0/1/10)
Networking & LANRealtek 2.5GbE Ethernet LAN (2.5 Gbps / 1 Gbps / 100 Mbps)
Rear I/O Connectivity1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C + 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A + 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Ports + 4 x USB 2.0 Ports
Display Outputs2 x DisplayPort 1.4 (3840x2160@144Hz) + 1 x HDMI 2.1 Port (4096x2160@60Hz)
Audio HardwareRealtek High Definition Audio CODEC (7.1-Channel Support) + Premium Audio Capacitors
DIY & Thermal FeaturesEZ-Latch PCIe Slot Release, M.2 Thermal Guard Heatsink, Q-Flash Plus Button & Smart Fan 6
Form Factor & DimensionsMicro-ATX Form Factor (24.4cm x 24.4cm)
